operation_sequences.source: Popescu (2019), section 6.4.1, pp. 113-114 (symbols placed on a needles x passes grid become operations and selections, then carriage direction and yarn-guide movement are simulated to detect errors before the machine file is written; footnote 8: zone = yarn guide, symbol = operation; footnote 9: knitting with yarn and transfer without yarn, both possible in one symbol; footnote 12: a colour is not a fixed symbol); Fig. 6.18 (symbols and clusters); Fig. 7.34g-k, p. 152 (knit front and back; float front, knit back; knit front and back then transfer front to back; knit front and back then drop the front stitch); section 7.3.4, p. 153 (two yarn guides, one per bed).
available: knit-sequence: every program as passes in knitting order, each with a direction, a racking and one symbol per needle; symbols of ordered yarn-fed (knit, tuck by guide and bed) and yarn-free steps (transfer with a needle offset, the class key's same-bed move, drop); clusters repeated over cells from an anchor
lossless conversion from the class-key bitmap (each cell keeps its key operation); conversion back refused, naming pass and needle, when the key has no operation for a symbol
symbolic executor in every mode: live loops per needle on both beds, each loop's parents, yarn-guide positions
panel section 'Operation sequence' (counts, findings with Show in the program), report section, Operation sequence JSON download
project_rules: in each pass, every yarn-fed step in carriage order, then every yarn-free step; moved loops land together after the pass's departures

a transfer from front needle n with offset o lands on back needle n + o and needs racking o; from back needle n it lands on front needle n + o and needs racking -o (sign convention, not a machine value)
one racking per pass; a symbol has yarn-fed steps before yarn-free steps and at most one yarn-fed step per bed

a yarn guide sits where its last stitch was; a pass without its stitches leaves it there; a jump is a first stitch more than one needle from where it stopped; the wrong side is a pass in the same direction as its previous pass with stitches
blocking: a transfer or move to a needle outside the program blocks the BMP and Knit Grammar JSON (the class key's 'transfer off the edge', a warning before, now also blocks)
transfers in one pass that need different rackings block export

stitches on empty needles, stacked loops, transfers from empty needles, drops, loops left at the end, yarn-guide jumps and the wrong side are reported only; the shaping check still blocks shape mode as before
the sequence JSON is always downloadable and carries the findings and blockers
